jobs.title: QA Engineer with German
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Our client is looking for a Software Tester / QA Engineer ideally performing also automated testing.
As a Software Tester / QA Engineer, you will support our development team in quality assurance and the further development of the KIDICAP application in the public-sector environment. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and the customer to ensure that new and existing functionalities are implemented reliably and to a high quality standard.

Analyzing functional and technical requirements and deriving suitable test scenarios and test cases
Planning, creating, executing, and documenting software tests
Performing functional tests, regression tests, as well as integration and end-to-end tests
Testing new functionalities, enhancements, and bug fixes
Quality assurance of frontend, backend, and interface functionalities
Testing legal and functional changes within the KIDICAP application
Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects
Re-testing fixed defects and performing regression tests
Supporting the creation and further development of automated tests
Maintaining and enhancing existing test cases and test documentation
Analyzing and documenting test results
Close collaboration with developers on defect analysis and resolution

Actively contributing to the continuous improvement of our QA and testing processes

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
At least 5 years of experience in software testing / quality assurance
Experience in creating and executing manual and, ideally, automated tests
Good knowledge of functional tests, regression tests, as well as integration and end-to-end tests
Experience with test and defect management
Knowledge of Tosca or comparable test automation tools is an advantage
Experience with Jira or comparable tools

Experience in an agile development environment
Analytical and structured working style as well as a strong quality mindset
Strong communication skills and enjoyment of collaboration in international and distributed teams

jobs.title: QA Manager
jobs.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Lead and shape the QA function at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world's leading insurers
100% remote, with a global, diverse team
Own quality strategy for a fast-growing product suite, with a direct line to the Head of QA and real influence over how we build
About Us
At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.
We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
We're the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
We've grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
We're constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world
What You Will Do
Strategy, Process & Governance
Provide full oversight of the testing lifecycle across multiple teams and projects, defining and enforcing QA processes and standardizing tools, environments, and test coverage organization-wide
Establish and continuously refine QA processes, procedures, and standards for testing products before they go to market
Ensure scalable test infrastructure, and extend our testing capability into advanced domains including performance, security, and compliance testing
Identify systemic quality gaps and cross-team risks, run trend analysis on quality metrics, and anticipate issues that could affect release stability or timelines
Evaluate and resolve organizational blockers in QA workflows, balancing trade-offs and delivery timelines while protecting stakeholder satisfaction
Deliver executive-level QA insights — reports, dashboards, and strategic recommendations — to the Head of QA and cross-functional leadership
Team Leadership
Manage and mentor QA Leads and senior individual contributors, fostering career growth, succession planning, and technical leadership across the QA organization
Distribute workload, set goals for QA Leads and their teams, and conduct performance reviews across the function
Drive continuous performance evaluation and improvement of QA teams — resolving conflicts, supporting morale, and building a culture of ownership, accountability, and excellence
Be the advocate for Agile testing and quality across the business, building quality awareness at every stage of the product lifecycle
Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Oversee QA engineers and Leads testing our products and implementing automation across cross-functional teams
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business analysts to shape requirements and comprehensive testing strategies
Participate in reviews of software requirements, design documents, and system architecture, ensuring testing requirements are addressed early
Manage and triage reported defects, and keep visibility over how features delivered by other teams interact across subsystems
Continuously improve and refactor our testing infrastructure and automated/regression frameworks to ensure reliability and scalability
What We Need
Experience & Leadership
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
8+ years of experience in software QA spanning both manual and automated testing of web and API applications, including at least 2+ years directly managing QA Leads, senior engineers, or a multi-team QA function
Experience in the insurance or a similarly regulated, complex industry is a strong plus
Proven track record establishing QA processes, tooling, and standards organization-wide, not just within a single team
Experience navigating executive-level reporting — comfortable turning quality metrics into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
Technical Depth
Deep understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes across the full testing lifecycle
Experience implementing and scaling automated testing frameworks in an agile environment, with deep understanding of BDD and Gherkin
Hands-on familiarity with testing tools for JavaScript and .NET such as Jest, Mocha, JMeter, Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer, NUnit, Cucumber, Telerik, Specflow, or similar, and how to integrate them with CI
Proficient with defect tracking and test management tooling, with strong experience setting up QA processes and running structured performance reviews
Working knowledge of performance, security, and compliance testing domains
Practical experience building and rolling out AI-powered processes across teams or workflows
Why You'll Love Working Here
100% Remote Work

Annual Performance Bonus
Remote Work Allowance

Hands-on experience with a bug tracking or issue management system (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira), including triage, severity classification, and status reporting.

Organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple partner channels and open-issue backlogs without letting items age.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (PHP)
jobs.description:
Most QA work is keeping a stable system stable. This is different. You'll hold quality high on a large-scale marketplace that's being rebuilt and migrated while it runs.
There's a live migration from GCP to AWS and a full version 2 build underway.
This is an initial 3 to 6 month contract, starting as soon as possible.
You'll embed into one of our product squads as its quality engineer, alongside a tech lead, a principal engineer, three full-stack engineers and a platform engineer. You'll be the squad's quality lead, owning test coverage, automation and validation standards for everything it ships.
Day to day, you'll write and maintain automated tests, shape the squad's test approach, help manage releases and improve how we deploy.
This is a capacity role alongside an established permanent team, so you'll need to be productive quickly without a long ramp.
The platform
This is a large-scale marketplace. Very few platforms handle a product catalogue or transaction volume at this level.
It runs on PHP and Laravel today, moving towards a service-based architecture in TypeScript and Node, so you'll be testing across both as the stack shifts.
The roadmap includes agentic AI workflows built into the platform, retail media integrated directly into the marketplace, and infrastructure work targeting cost and performance at high volume. Much of this is being attempted at volumes rarely tested in a marketplace before, so the work leans research-led rather than routine.
Who This Suits
A fast-paced environment where the ground shifts. You'll do well if you're comfortable with ambiguity and can hold a standard while things move around you.
Location and basis
Contractors engage on a B2B basis.
Fully flexible working: home, office, or a mix, your call. We just ask that you're based within one of these areas:
Bulgaria: within 80km of Sofia
Romania: within 80km of Cluj, Bucharest or Iasi
Applications from outside these areas won't be considered.
What We Need
The essentials:
5+ years in manual and automated testing, senior enough to set standards and deliver without close oversight
Solid PHP, plus one other language (TypeScript, Java, C# or Python)
Confident across manual and automated testing, and can build, maintain and extend test frameworks
Hands-on experience with Cypress
Can own releases end to end: planning, coordinating, shipping to production
Track record of improving deployment processes
Strong grasp of SDLC QA: planning, test cases, bug tracking, reporting
Hands-on with a test case management system such as TestRail
Comfortable working in English, written and spoken
Also Needed
Working understanding of OOP principles and design patterns
Good knowledge of CI/CD systems
Experience with test reporting tools and services
Nice To Have
Playwright with TypeScript used professionally
Hands-on with AWS
GenAI tools already part of your day-to-day QA workflow
Ready to apply?
Submit your application below.
